description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Turkish Tactician Style, 7 ranks in Sense Motive and 3 ranks in Bluff

Benefit: While in Turkish Tactician Style and you have performed an Assessment, you can perform a Bluff check to convey a message to an ally within 30 feet, granting them the benefits of Assessment as if they used it themselves.

system.requirements: Turkish Tactician Style, 7 ranks in Sense Motive and 3 ranks in Bluff
